plan.title: PR Auction Split Award to PO

steps.note: Enable partial awarding required by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation for the sourcing event.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.

args.goal: add one Required T&C clause on the buyer's event create screen and stop with the clause visibly added

steps.note: Add the required T&C because no dedicated catalog step performs this action.
Invite two QA vendors so two independent bids can be submitted without inventing real supplier names.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Submit the first vendor's quote of 100 through the vendor bidding flow.
Verify the first quote was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's quote of 90 through the next vendor bidding flow.
Verify the second quote was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before reading ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify that the lower quote ranks better and that both vendor bids are ranked.
Enter the award allocation screen, the closest available screen for the requested split award.
Allocate the line to an available vendor to exercise the supported awarding flow; quantity splitting is not expressible.
Assert the award screen records one selected line and one selected vendor, while documenting that the requested two-vendor split cannot be performed.
